stem: Joe would like to add a sentence to support the idea he has presented in sentence 14. Which of these could BEST follow and support sentence 14?

options.label: F
options.text: According to the staff, once Jasmine and the fawn met, they were inseparable.

options.label: G
options.text: Clearly, the fawn was just a little baby at 11 weeks old.

options.label: H
options.text: Jasmine preferred to take care of animals that were similar to her.

options.label: J
options.text: Bunnies, badgers, guinea pigs, birds, and fawns—Jasmine cared for a strange mix of animals.
